related.title: 霍恩斯代爾儲能電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「占傍晚尖峰的比例」與「熱失控的能量尺度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩斯代爾儲能電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of the evening peak" and "The energy scale of thermal runaway" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsdale Power Reserve must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界最大的電池與它的火災：四小時時長、套利、防火分區與灑水；霍恩斯代爾儲能電站則以改變電網儲能觀念的大電池：頻率變化率、虛擬慣量、調頻成本與風場搭配為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest battery and its fire: four-hour duration, arbitrage, fire compartments and sprinklers; Hornsdale Power Reserve centres on the big battery that changed how grids see storage: rate of change of frequency, virtual inertia, frequency-control cost and pairing with wind, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「功率、能量與時長」與「功率、能量與時長」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「往返效率與損失」的模型移到霍恩斯代爾儲能電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「虛擬慣量能提供的功率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "Round-trip efficiency and losses" to Hornsdale Power Reserve, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Power from virtual inertia", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「占傍晚尖峰的比例」與「熱失控的能量尺度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩斯代爾儲能電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of the evening peak" and "The energy scale of thermal runaway" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsdale Power Reserve must be respecified.

related.title: 儲能電站故障隔離與調度
related.titleEn: Energy Storage Fault Isolation and Dispatch
related.transfer: 可遷移「占傍晚尖峰的比例」與「熱失控的能量尺度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；儲能電站故障隔離與調度的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of the evening peak" and "The energy scale of thermal runaway" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Energy Storage Fault Isolation and Dispatch must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界最大的電池與它的火災：四小時時長、套利、防火分區與灑水；儲能電站故障隔離與調度則以一顆電芯出事之後：排氣與爆炸下限、通風、熔絲、隔離後的調度與電弧能量為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest battery and its fire: four-hour duration, arbitrage, fire compartments and sprinklers; Energy Storage Fault Isolation and Dispatch centres on after one cell fails: vented gas and the explosive limit, ventilation, fuses, dispatch after isolation and arc energy, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「功率、能量與時長」與「功率、能量與時長」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「往返效率與損失」的模型移到儲能電站故障隔離與調度，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「隔離一個電池架後的剩餘容量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "Round-trip efficiency and losses" to Energy Storage Fault Isolation and Dispatch, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Capacity left after isolating one rack", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「占傍晚尖峰的比例」與「熱失控的能量尺度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；儲能電站故障隔離與調度的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of the evening peak" and "The energy scale of thermal runaway" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Energy Storage Fault Isolation and Dispatch must be respecified.

history.title: 莫斯蘭丁儲能系統
history.text: 2020 年第一期啟用；2021 年第二期啟用；2023 年第三期啟用；2025 年第一期廠房發生大火。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2020: Phase I opened. 2021: Phase II opened. 2023: Phase III opened. 2025: The phase I building burned. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
